spec.description: Monitoring for sanoid (ZFS snapshot management) and syncoid (ZFS replication). Requires Prometheus node_exporter textfile collector with --prometheus-textfile enabled on each host.

spec.title: Current Snapshot Counts by Dataset and Type
Last Run Status
spec.description: 1 = all runs succeeded, 0 = at least one failure

spec.title: Bytes Sent Estimated (per dataset)
spec.description: Pre-send estimate from 'zfs send -nvP'. 0 for bookmark-based sends.

spec.title: Throughput (per dataset)
spec.description: Estimated bytes per second = bytes_sent / sync_duration

spec.title: Target Snapshot Count (per dataset)
spec.description: Total number of snapshots on the target dataset after each sync run

spec.title: Time Since Last Run
spec.description: Elapsed time since the last sanoid run started

spec.title: Total Snapshots Managed
spec.description: Sum of all managed snapshots across all types for the selected pools

spec.title: Sanoid / Syncoid — ZFS Monitoring
